## PreflightCheck.error property

Structured, remediation-free error context when this check failed with a recognized error, so a caller can build its own remediation message instead of parsing the `reason` prose. Populated only for the `config` check when the config file is present but invalid.

**Signature:**

```typescript
error?: PreflightCheckError | undefined;
```
